text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — we're pushing SDK 4.3.1 to canary now. It includes a lightweight compatibility shim for legacy transports, a tweak to default retry backoff (0.5s -> 0.8s), and a docs cleanup plan. No immediate breaking changes for most users, but TransportV1 will be deprecated in 90 days. PR: https://git.redwood/example/4.3.1
Maria Ortiz: Will this impact Dedicated or Private customers who pinned older SDKs?
Alex Chen: Not at runtime for pinned server deployments. The change is client-side behavior in the SDK. If you pin an SDK binary, nothing changes unless you update.
Jamal Singh: Rollout cadence? Canary -> staged -> 100%?
Alex Chen: Canary now to ~5% traffic for 24h, monitor errors/latency. If green, 25% for 48h, then 100%. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.5% or latency p95 increase >15%.
DocsBot: Docs preview is live: https://docs.redwood/preview/sdk-4-3-1. It includes a dedicated migration guide and a new "compatibility tests" badge for CI.
Emily Zhao: I'll add a small migration helper script to examples/transport-migrate.sh and a sample diff. Want it to be copy-paste friendly.
Maria Ortiz: Can we get a clear deprecation page with exact code diffs and a FAQ for support?
Alex Chen: Already drafted: https://docs.redwood/preview/deprecations/transportv1 (working copy). It has code snippets: ````bash
# old use
client = RedwoodClient(transport=TransportV1(url))
# new use
client = RedwoodClient(transport=TransportV2(url, keepalive=True))
````
Jamal Singh: Any telemetry or opt-in flags changed?
Alex Chen: No telemetry changes. We did add a `compat_shim=true` opt-in flag for debugging; it's off by default for stable.
Maria Ortiz: What about SDKs in other languages? Node/Rust/Go parity?
Alex Chen: Node and Go have matching shims in this release. Rust will follow in the next minor (4.4.0) — ETA ~3 weeks.
Emily Zhao: I'll sync the examples across repo and add a small note in the Quickstart. Also adding a migration checklist for Solutions.
InfraBot: Canary deployment started at 2067894569. Watch metrics dashboard: https://observability.redwood/canary/4.3.1
Jamal Singh: Thanks. I'll hold off on any dependent infra changes until 25% is confirmed green.
Maria Ortiz: Ping me when the deprecation page is ready for legal review — we need the explicit 90-day language.
Alex Chen: Will do. I'll also post a short customer-facing blurb for Public Announcements after 100% rollout, and include migration links.
Emily Zhao: small nit: please add a migration note to the SDK CHANGELOG highlighting the retry backoff change so customers scanning the changelog don't miss it.
Alex Chen: Good call. Added to the changelog draft.
Maria Ortiz: :thumbsup:
Jamal Singh: :+1:
DocsBot: Reminder: if you see anything in the preview that looks off, open an issue with `docs-preview` label and tag @Emily Zhao.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — will report back at the 25% checkpoint or earlier if anything shows up.
